snippet.title: Minecraft CTM Speedrun • Calamity Canyon • 7:38.63 [WR]
snippet.description:
didn't even beat the tas :/

previous wr: 13:43 by ty_sr https://youtu.be/coIqQY2frXk
tas: 7:04 by zonkmasterx https://youtu.be/xv8fVqPOl6c
leaderboard: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/13TaKCvVBF5MyeKoINNusfUGsvN52eKs_l_hJ32uNS4A/edit#gid=953295625

calamity canyon the 5th installment of the untold stories series by renderxr. minecraft

map download: https://ctmrepository.com/index.php?action=viewMap&id=34
ctm speedrun discord: https://discord.gg/QN4wQTat4J

decently solid run to beat the previous wr holder by 6 minutes. this map is very rng intensive, & i take a lot of risks with difficult elytra movement on top of that. even though i ran this in easy, completing a run of this route is probably overall harder than the previous route on hard difficulty

in this run i get essentially perfect rng, & only a handful of minor execution mistakes (namely bonking the monument fountain & excruciatingly slow mineral block crafting). i kind of wish i got this time with it the other way around, since it'd look nicer, but y'know

more rng strats can be added, like the looting the random chest for a pick & axe, or killing an early enderman. without being close to any major milestone, & without any threat of competition from ty retiring, i have no motivation to grind this lower

played on minecraft 1.12.2 on easy
~400-500 attempts
raw footage: https://youtu.be/tUJkxj66E80?t=67

music: the comet is coming - march of the rising sun
